heard: An explosion flattened 80 million trees without leaving any impact crater. On the morning of June 30, 1908, a blinding flash lit the skies over Siberia. The cataclysm destroyed forest across 2,100 square kilometers. Seismic stations across Eurasia detected airwaves far away in Europe and the United States. Night skies across Europe and Asia glowed for days due to high altitude dust and ice particles. Researchers eventually concluded a stony asteroid exploded high in the atmosphere in an airburst. Microscopic extraterrestrial silicate and magnetite spheres were discovered trapped in tree resin. An explosion flattened 80 million trees without leaving any impact crater.
